crons.//: Hourly, not daily. The retention rule is already relative to each submission's own completedAt/submittedAt — but a job that runs once a day can only notice that a 24h window elapsed up to 24h late, so 'delete 24h after completion' silently meant 24-48h. Hourly narrows that to 24-25h. The sweep is idempotent and skips already-purged rows, so running it more often costs a query and nothing else.
